description: This file implements a principles-based evaluation pattern for constitutional reasoning, including functions for loading principles from YAML, individual principle checkers, aggregation of results, and orchestration of full and quick evaluations within a reasoning framework.

methods.name: register_constitutional_reasoners
methods.description: Registers all constitutional-related reasoners with the provided router, including loading principles, individual checks, aggregation, and orchestration functions.

methods.name: load_constitution
methods.description: Loads evaluation principles from a YAML configuration file, supporting domain-specific weight overrides.

methods.name: check_principle
methods.description: Generic principle checker that evaluates adherence to a given principle using an AI model.

methods.name: check_no_fabrication
methods.description: Dedicated checker for the 'No Fabrication' principle.

methods.name: check_accurate_attribution
methods.description: Dedicated checker for the 'Accurate Attribution' principle.

methods.name: check_safety
methods.description: Dedicated checker for the 'No Harmful Advice' principle.

methods.name: check_uncertainty_expression
methods.description: Dedicated checker for the 'Uncertainty Expression' principle.

methods.name: aggregate_constitutional
methods.description: Aggregates individual principle check results into a final constitutional report, weighing scores and identifying violations.

methods.name: evaluate_constitutional_full
methods.description: Orchestrates a full constitutional evaluation by loading principles, checking each in parallel, and aggregating results.

methods.name: evaluate_constitutional_quick
methods.description: Performs a quick, single-call evaluation of all principles, returning a summary report.
